title: Insha za Kiuamilifu (Theme 5: Mitazamo hasi ya kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains a diary and its features: the date, first person, the events and feelings of the day, and the kinds (ya kibinafsi, ya kazi).

floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu siku yako.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the features of the entry.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Shajara ni nini?" Kwa nini "barua kwa rafiki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Shajara ni kumbukumbu ya kila siku.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Shajara huandikwa kwa nafsi ipi?" Kwa nini "ya tatu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Shajara huandikwa kwa nafsi ya kwanza.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kila ingizo la shajara huanza kwa nini?" Kwa nini "jina la rafiki" si jibu sahihi?

listen_for: kwa ajili ya mwalimu na wazazi
misconceptions.repair: Shajara ya kibinafsi ni ya mwandishi; huonyesha hisia zake.

checks.question: Kila ingizo la shajara huanza na nini?
Shajara ya kibinafsi huandikwa kwa nafsi gani?

skills.key_step: The child plans shajara before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Siku Niliyopinga Mtazamo Hasi".

misconceptions.repair: Kila ingizo la shajara huanza na tarehe.
Shajara ya kibinafsi huandikwa kwa nafsi ya kwanza.

misconceptions.ask: Ingizo hili linahusu hisia au shughuli za kazi?
misconceptions.repair: Shajara ya kazi huandika shughuli na miadi; ya kibinafsi huandika hisia na matukio ya mtu.
Shajara haina salamu wala hitimisho la barua.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika shajara kuhusu "Siku Niliyopinga Mtazamo Hasi"?
Shajara ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: tarehe, ingizo kwa nafsi ya kwanza
